id: title:carlos-marchal-ph:open stateless traces on the user visible generation

review.posthog_relevance: Adds database support and access-control checks for a new AI state-length optimization, preserving security and query correctness.
review.reason: The change adds a database column and metadata to support a lightweight state-length check, establishes the mapping between this subcolumn and the source property, and includes a regression test. This supports the implementation and access-control correctness of a new optimization, warranting a tier 2. No tier 3 systemic benefit or tier 1-only maintenance is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the implementation and checks being complete and effective; no tier 3 systemic benefit or tier 1-only maintenance is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; scoring is done after this chunk is complete.

observations.behavior: Adds a new hidden database field and its metadata, and a shared mapping, to support the new state-length check.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a database column to store the byte length of input/output state JSON without loading the full state, enabling a lightweight check for whether state exists. This supports the new trace-query optimization that avoids loading large state blobs when not needed.

observations.behavior: Adds a shared dictionary mapping subcolumn names to their source property, and extends the mirrored-column lookup to include these subcolumns.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes the relationship between the stored length subcolumn and the source property, allowing the access-control and query-rewriting layers to treat the length field as a proxy for the state property. This is required for the subsequent state-length checks.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test assertion and a new optional parameter to the existing property-access-control test, and updates the assertion to use the printed column when available.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a regression test for the new state-length masking behavior, ensuring that the access-control rules correctly hide the state length when the state property is restricted. This preserves the security and correctness of the access-control implementation.
